verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop is an OS, not a web service, so an OpenAPI spec is not expected. However, its documentation publishes AT-SPI D-Bus XML interface definitions (e.g. org.a11y.atspi.Accessible, org.a11y.atspi.Action), which are a machine-readable API description of an 'equivalent' kind. The evidence is only a single table-of-contents mention covering one accessibility subsystem. missing for 10: explicit evidence the spec files are downloadable, coverage of OS APIs beyond accessibility, any OpenAPI-style spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
